terms.intro: By using our services you accept the following terms. We recommend reading them carefully before booking any service.
terms.s1_p1: By accessing and using the Reyssi Travels website, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of them, please do not use our services.
terms.s2_p1: Bookings are subject to availability and confirmation by our suppliers. Full or partial payment must be made as agreed in the quote sent to you.
terms.s2_p2: Reyssi Travels acts as an intermediary and is not responsible for last-minute changes made by external suppliers such as airlines, hotels or carriers. Any additional charge for changes will be notified before it is applied.
terms.s3_p1: Cancellation policies vary depending on the tour package and the corresponding supplier. Specific details will be provided with the quote and before payment is made.
terms.s3_p2: Reyssi Travels will charge an administrative fee on any applicable refund. No refunds will be issued for no-shows on the day of travel.
terms.s4_p1: Reyssi Travels acts exclusively as an intermediary between the traveler and tourism service providers (airlines, hotels, operators, etc.). We are not responsible for delays, cancellations, losses or incidents beyond our direct control.
terms.s4_p2: Travelers are responsible for holding the required documentation (valid passport, visas, etc.) for the selected destinations.
terms.s5_p1: All website content —including text, images, logos, graphics and design— is the property of Reyssi Travels or used under license. It may not be reproduced, distributed or modified without prior written authorization.
terms.s6_p1: For any questions, clarifications or requests related to these terms, you can write to us at reservas@reyssitravels.com or contact us directly on WhatsApp. We'll be happy to help.

privacy.intro: At Reyssi Travels we take the protection of your personal data seriously. Learn how we collect, use and safeguard it.
privacy.s1_p1: Reyssi Travels, based in Mexico City, Mexico, is responsible for the processing and protection of your personal data. We are committed to complying with applicable privacy and data protection laws.
privacy.s2_p1: We collect the information needed to quote and manage your trips: full name, email, phone number and, in some cases, passenger data required by suppliers.
privacy.s2_p2: We do not collect sensitive data without your express consent. All information is obtained directly through our contact and quote forms.
privacy.s3_p1: Your personal data will be used exclusively for the following purposes:
privacy.s3_p2:
— Quoting and managing the trips and tour packages you request.
— Sending deals and special offers (only if you have previously authorized it).
— Improving our services and customer care.
— Complying with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.s4_p1: We implement administrative, technical and physical security measures to protect your information against damage, loss, alteration, destruction or unauthorized access. Your data is stored in secure systems with restricted access.
privacy.s5_p1: You have the right to exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition (ARCO) at any time. To do so, send your request to reservas@reyssitravels.com and we will respond shortly.
privacy.s5_p2: Your request must include your full name, registered email and a clear description of the right you wish to exercise.
privacy.s6_p1: This privacy notice may be updated periodically. Any relevant change will be announced on our website. We recommend checking this page regularly to stay informed.
